answer: Attention-Decay Credentialing. Each identity must complete a quartz-timed micro-task chain, spaced unpredictably, that only yields credentials if response latency stays under a threshold across a voyage of sessions. Attacker cost: parallelizing fake identities requires the same finite operator attention, since each chain resets on missed windows. A comet-shaped audit trail logs timing entropy, so farmed identities lose credentials faster than they earn them, making sustained attention the real per-identity expense.
